We refunded the lights and only charged you for labor which is completely fair since work had already been done.  It’s easy to blame the shop, but the truth is simple you wanted premium results on a tight budget and with old headlights. We didn’t charge you any extra chargers!!

Quality comes at a price if you don’t want to spend, don’t put the blame on us.  Please don’t mislead others with false claims.

Hi Saif,

Let me set the record straight. Nachi is the OEM clutch supplier for Toyota Thailand, as we’ve explained to you before. If you purchase a Toyota Thailand part, it’s Nachi that you’ll find inside the box. This is a fact, not an assumption.

We also clearly informed you that buying directly from Nachi is more cost effective. At no point did we force you to make a purchase. You had every opportunity to inspect the part when you opened the box. If there were any doubts, you could have raised them right then and there but you didn’t.

As per our return policy, you had the option to return the part and choose something else. Instead, you chose a replacement. That was your decision, not ours.

Let me make one thing absolutely clear: we do not sell fake products. Our reputation is built on trust and integrity, and we take that very seriously. Yes, I admit to mistakenly providing you with the wrong clutch bearing because mistakes can happen. But twisting facts and making false claims to tarnish our name is unacceptable and unethical.

I expect you to take accountability for your actions and refrain from spreading baseless accusations that harm my business.


Thank you.
